text: Among households in areas of the same summer temperature, one more person goes with about 86 litres more a day (95% interval 84 to 89), and each degree of summer temperature with about 20 litres more. These are comparisons between different households in 2,000 metered homes, not the effect of adding a person to a home, and other differences between areas that we did not measure may still be mixed into both numbers.
